services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Vetta Sports Summer Camp is a top-rated summer camp in St. Louis for children ages 5-12. Our all-day program keeps kids active and engaged with a fun mix of sports, games, creative activities, and indoor play-giving families a safe, structured, and exciting summer camp experience.From soccer and kickball to arts & crafts and water play, campers enjoy something new each day while building confidence and friendships. Led by experienced, caring counselors, our camp is a place where kids feel welcome-whether it’s their first summer or a familiar favorite.
